text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring). On a stage where 
top contenders gather, TM Opera O, 
radiating a distinct aura, loudly 
proclaims the "dawn of a new era."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've no intention of getting dragged into 
your opera. Even so, I won't surrender the 
spotlight of the 'lead' to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega headed into the fierce spring 
battle against TM Opera O and Narita Top 
Road.
